subject: Sandbox spike and VAT applied to test calls — explanation and remediation
messages:
From: Aisha Bhatt <billing@cartwave.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: CartWave Finance <finance@cartwave.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected charges for 'sandbox' / VAT applied to test tokens

Hi Mateo,

We just received the March invoice and there is a line showing ~1.2M tokens charged against the environment labeled 'sandbox-test'. Those calls were supposed to be non-billable test traffic routed to your free sandbox. On top of that, VAT was applied to the line which is unexpected for our EU billing flow — we are a US company (CartWave Inc.).

Attached is a CSV extract (cartwave_sandbox_usage_202803.csv) from our telemetry that maps the request_id and timestamp to the API key prefix we were using. Can you please: 
- Confirm why sandbox traffic was billed in our production invoice
- Confirm whether VAT should have been applied and if not, how you plan to correct it
- Provide a provisional credit or hold on the invoice while you investigate

We're on a tight close window; please let us know the earliest ETA for an update.

Thanks,
Aisha Bhatt
Head of Billing Operations
CartWave Inc.

--
Attachment: cartwave_sandbox_usage_202803.csv (CSV, 48 KB, 3 columns: request_id,timestamp,api_key_prefix)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Bhatt <billing@cartwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected charges for 'sandbox' / VAT applied to test tokens

Hi Aisha — thanks for the heads up and for sending the CSV. I've looped in Ben (sales lead) and Marissa (finance) so we can cover the billing & tax side. Quick acknowledgement: we will pause any collections related to this invoice while we investigate.

Questions for your team while we dig in:
- Can you confirm whether the API keys in your CSV correspond to named sandbox keys you manage, or are they generated dynamically by your staging infra?
- Do you have any recent infra changes (CI/CD, key rotation, proxy changes) around March 18-24?
- Are the affected calls all to our text-generation endpoint, or do you see embeddings/reranker traffic mixed in?

Next steps on our side (we aim to have an initial root-cause summary within 48 hours):
1) Ben will pull the routing logs to see whether any sandbox-key prefixes were routed to a billable cluster.
2) Marissa & I will confirm tax treatment (VAT applied) with our tax engine and finance ledger.
3) We'll prepare a provisional credit note if this looks like a misattribution.

I'll follow up with an update by EOD Wednesday PST. If anything is time-sensitive, DM me and I'll prioritize.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Mar 2028 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: sandbox spike and VAT applied to test calls — quick log scrub

Mateo / Marissa — I pulled a quick sample from our edge routing for the CartWave account. Summary below; see attached scrub for raw rows (prelim_metering_scrub_20280326.txt).

Summary (prelim):
- Between 2028-03-19 02:00 UTC and 2028-03-21 05:30 UTC we see ~1.18M requests with API key prefix matching cartwave-staging-* being routed to the prod-cluster-1 (billable).
- The routing rule that normally maps cartwave-staging-* to the free-sandbox-cluster did not match for a short window — looks like a recent change in our prefix normalization logic rejected keys with an underscore (we accepted hyphens only). CartWave's CI created keys with an underscore (e.g., cartwave_staging_01) during a rollout on 2028-03-18.
- VAT applied: our billing engine applied VAT because the account billing profile indicates EU VAT flag false, but the invoice generator used the account address on file which had an EU VAT override set during a prior support flow (erroneously persisted).

Immediate remediation performed (already):
- I pushed a config rollback to restore the previous prefix-normalizer so staging prefixes with underscores route to free-sandbox-cluster.
- Temporarily exempted CartWave's account from automated invoice finalization (collection hold) while we complete a forensic tie-out.

Action items remaining:
- Marissa to confirm the refundable VAT treatment and create the credit note.
- Mateo to coordinate with CartWave on which invoice number to apply the provisional credit to.
- Ben to produce a full log trace for the 1.18M requests (this will be ~12MB).

Attaching: prelim_metering_scrub_20280326.txt (truncated sample).

-Ben

--
Attachment: prelim_metering_scrub_20280326.txt (text, 120 KB, sample rows: request_id,api_key,route,ts,status)
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Bhatt <billing@cartwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox spike and VAT applied to test calls — explanation and remediation

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for your patience — below is a short summary, our remediation proposal, and next steps.

Root cause (what happened)
- During CartWave's staging rollout on 2028-03-18 your CI generated API keys with underscores (example: cartwave_staging_01). Our prefix-normalization logic (recent change deployed 2028-03-17) only accepted hyphen-delimited prefixes. Keys with underscores failed the normalization and therefore matched the default production routing path. That caused roughly 1.18M staging requests to be routed to prod-cluster-1 and recorded as billable tokens.
- Separately, your account profile had a prior manual VAT override (EU flag) that was accidentally left set. Because invoice finalization used the override field, VAT got applied.

What we've done already
- Rolled back the normalization change so keys with underscores will again hit the free sandbox route.
- Placed the disputed invoice on collection hold and paused any automated collections for CartWave.
- Generated a provisional detailed log export (we'll deliver the full trace as a drive link) and attached a short sample for your review.

Proposed remediation
1) Full credit for the misrouted billable tokens: we propose a credit of 1,180,000 token units (converted to invoice currency at the billed unit rate) applied to invoice #202803-CW-4857. We will issue credit_note_CW-4857.pdf once Marissa confirms the amount.
2) VAT reversal: Marissa will generate a tax adjustment reversing VAT on the misattributed line and issue a corrected invoice (no VAT). If CartWave prefers a refund instead of credit, we can process a refund and reissue a clean invoice — let us know which you prefer.
3) Post-mortem & preventative steps: we'll schedule a 30-min tech sync (Ben + Mateo + your infra lead) to review key naming conventions and add a parity test to our CI so future prefix-normalizer changes have a safety gate.

ETA and next steps
- Marissa will confirm credit amount and post the credit note by EOD Thursday PST.
- Ben will upload the full 12MB trace to the Drive link and share it with your infra team for cross-checking.
- Please confirm whether you want credit applied vs refund. If refund, include wire details and preferred refund method.

Again — sorry for the disruption. We consider this our operational error and will make CartWave whole for the misbilled tokens + reverse VAT for that line.

Best regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0193

Cc: Marissa Cole (Finance) — Marissa, can you confirm the provisional credit amount and VAT reversal approach?

--
Attachment: credit_note_CW-4857.pdf (PDF stub, 14 KB)
